transcript.text: Welcome to Onprint Shop.
In this tutorial, we'll explore an exciting new feature, the ability to apply the same template design to other products.
This not only makes cross selling easier, but also helps customers design faster and complete their purchases with less effort.
Let's begin with how this works for customers.
On the product information page, they'll see a new block called Explore Products with same design.
Here, the configured products are displayed with their 2D models in the default size.
The customer's current design is automatically applied as a live preview of these products whenever they make changes to the design.
All previews update instantly across the assigned products.
Once they find a product they'd like to use the same design for, they simply click on it and the system loads that product with the current template, resizing it if needed.
This means customers can design once and apply it across multiple products, saving time and effort while making purchases faster.
Now let's see how admins configure this feature.
The first step is to enable this feature.
For this, in the admin panel, navigate to the Store Personalization module.
Then go to the Website Themes menu.
From the main screen, click on the Product Showcase Settings button.
Now Scroll down to the page and you will find a new section.
Explore Products with same design.
From the drop down.
Select Display Criteria from None to any of the four other options to enable the feature.
Once enabled, it is time to configure this feature.
Go to the Print Products or Ready to Buy Products listing screen in the Admin panel and click on the Related Products button in the top right corner.
On this page, you'll find the new Explore Products with Same Design option along with Related product settings.

Here you can choose from three configurations, none to skip this feature for the selected product specific products to assign selected products that will share the same design or refer from setting where the system will inherit the configuration defined in the Product Showcase settings under the Explore Products with Same Design section.
Make sure to save your configurations after selecting the desired option.
Finally, to control how this option appears on the storefront, go to Store Personalization and click on the Product page layout.
Open the Canvas tab and add the Explore Products with Same design block to the layout.
Once the block is added, don't forget to save the layout configuration to apply the changes.
This layout only applies to the Quick Design products.
Once configured, the Explore Products with Same Design block automatically appears on the storefront.
For Quick Design products, the block appears on the Product Details page, whereas for standard products it is displayed on the Product Details page.
Additional info page below the Add to Cart button and Cart page showing customers the eligible products.
And that's how you can let customers apply the same design across multiple products.
This feature streamlines the design process, boosts cross selling opportunities, and creates a faster, more convenient purchase experience.
Thank you for watching.
If you have any questions, our support executives are here to help.
Just reach out through live chat on onprintshop.com.
Thanks for tuning in.
